description: This file defines the DirectorySelectionFragment class, which demonstrates how to use Android's Directory Selection API to navigate and manage directories within an Android app. It includes UI interactions for opening directories, creating new subdirectories, and displaying directory contents using RecyclerView.

classes.name: DirectorySelectionFragment
classes.description: A Fragment that enables users to select directories, view their contents, and create subdirectories using the Directory API.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Factory method to create a new instance of DirectorySelectionFragment.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Lifecycle method called when the fragment is created.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes UI components, sets up button actions, and the RecyclerView adapter.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles the result from directory selection intent.

methods.name: updateDirectoryEntries
methods.description: Updates UI and internal state based on the selected directory Uri, lists child directories.

methods.name: createDirectory
methods.description: Creates a new directory under the specified directory Uri.

methods.name: closeQuietly
methods.description: Safely closes cursor or other AutoCloseable resources.
